test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 1 (Held on: 8 Aug 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

India is exporting handicrafts to several countries.

options.text: Handicrafts were exported to several countries by India.
Handicrafts are exported to several countries by India.
Handicrafts have been exported to several countries by India.
Handicrafts are being exported to several countries by India.

solution:
The correct answer is option 4) i.e. 'Handicrafts are being exported to several countries by India..'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The given sentence is in the active voice. We have to change the sentence into passive form. 
 
• The given sentence is written in 'present continuous tense.' 
 
• The structure of these kinds of sentences is:
 
 
• Active Voice: Subject + is/am/are + V1 + ing + Object.
 
• Passive Voice: Object + is/am/are + being + V3 + by + Subject
 
 
 
• Let’s see another **example**:
 
 
• Active voice: Neil is painting a beautiful flower.
 
• Passive voice: *A beautiful flower is being painted by Neil.*
 
 
 
• The subject of the given sentence is 'India' and the object of the given sentence is 'handicrafts'. 
 
• So, in the passive voice, the position of ‘subject’ and ‘object’ will be interchanged. 
 
• Also here, 'is exporting' will be changed into 'are being exported.' As 'Handicrafts'** **is plural in number so we have to use** 'are' **with it.
 
• Only **option 4 **fits with the structure of the passive voice.

 

Correct Sentence:__ *Handicrafts are being exported to several countries by India.*
